name: SpinDoctor Qwerty
description: Run the SpinDoctor 3.1.2 quantum-circuit SIMULATOR (classical FP64 on this computer, not a quantum computer, no quantum advantage; 1-298 logical qubits, 59 per entangled factor). action=script runs q.* commands (one per line, including q.folder run path="..."), action=preset runs qc-001..qc-241, action=list lists presets, action=report shows reports, action=functions shows the function table (show it verbatim), action=theory tests a theory (input = JSON with source file/text/chat, hypothesis, prediction, script, checks, excerpts). Every command writes TXT/PDF/JSON reports.
author: RUSSELL PHILIP SMITHSON <russellsmithson77@outlook.com>

input.hint: Python 3.8+ executable for the bundled SpinDoctor engine. Leave empty to use python3 (python on Windows).
Folder for SpinDoctor state and TXT/PDF/JSON reports. Leave empty for the default (~/spindoctor-workspace or $SPINDOCTOR_WORKSPACE).

examples.prompt: Build a Bell circuit and run 1000 shots with SpinDoctor
examples.call:
{"action": "script", "input": "q.circuit new bell 2
q.circuit add h 0
q.circuit add cx 0 1
q.circuit run shots 1000 basis z"}

examples.prompt: What can SpinDoctor do? Show me the functions
Test the theory we discussed: H then CNOT gives only 00 and 11
examples.call: {"action": "theory", "input": "{\"action\": \"run\", \"source\": \"chat\", \"text\": \"Theory: H(0) then CX(0,1) gives a Bell state. Prediction: only 00 and 11, ~0.5 each.\", \"excerpts\": [\"User: H then CNOT should only give 00 and 11\"], \"hypothesis\": \"H+CNOT makes a Bell state\", \"prediction\": \"P(00)=P(11)=0.5 +/- 0.05\", \"script\": \"q.circuit new b 2\\nq.circuit add h 0\\nq.circuit add cx 0 1\\nq.circuit run shots 2000 basis z\", \"checks\": [{\"kind\": \"probability\", \"outcome\": \"00\", \"expected\": 0.5, \"tolerance\": 0.05}]}"}

action.description: One of: script, preset, list, report, functions, theory

input.description: script: q.* commands, one per line; preset: preset id, optionally followed by name=value overrides (e.g. 'qc-061 shots=500'); list: filter text; report: report name (empty lists recent reports); functions: section (commands|gates|tools|presets|all) and an optional filter; theory: a JSON object with the spindoctor_test_theory fields (action, source file|text|chat, path, text, excerpts, hypothesis, prediction, script, checks)
